name: Things To Do Calendar App
summary: Real name: Haul Calendar. A curated real-events discovery calendar (car shows, flea/antique markets, vintage/thrift pop-ups, art & maker fairs, sports, Startup & Biz) across St. Cloud/St. Joseph and the Twin Cities. Manual by design: Jack says "update the hub" for a fresh research pass, and tells Claude in chat to add a specific event to his real Google Calendar, no automated refresh or auto-add button.

relationReasons.calendar: Both use Google Calendar as their single shared data source.
